BiblicalUsage: This word is a lifetime, a living, and it describes the ten concubines David shuts up after Absalom's rebellion, fed but never visited, living in widowhood until the day of their death. Their whole remaining life is summed in one word.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this verse is one of the saddest in David's story: women shut up for the rest of their lives because of a son's sin, and God records it without looking away.
